privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Ovnimizer is a free, open-source, non-commercial tool built for the community. We do not collect, store, or transmit any personal data or files.
privacy.localBody: Your images are processed using your device's CPU and memory via browser APIs (OffscreenCanvas). No file is uploaded to any server. When you close the tab, all data is gone.
privacy.noCollectionBody: We collect no data of any kind: no images, no metadata, no device information, no IP addresses. We have no way of knowing who uses this tool.
privacy.noTrackingBody: We do not use cookies, analytics tools, or any tracking technology. No ads, no user profiles, no monetization.
privacy.cloudIntegrationBody: Ovnimizer offers optional connections with Google Drive and Dropbox. Authentication happens directly between your browser and the provider — never through our servers. Files are downloaded from the cloud to your browser and processed locally. We never store tokens, credentials, or files at any point.
privacy.openSourceBody: Ovnimizer is a non-profit project built for the community. There is no business model or commercial interest. The code is free and open.
privacy.gdprBody: Since no personal data is processed or stored, Ovnimizer is fully compliant with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations worldwide. No cookie consent is required.

home.title: Developer tools that work instantly in your browser
home.subtitle: Format, convert, generate and inspect — dozens of fast, privacy-first utilities in one place. No accounts, no uploads, no clutter.
home.privacyDesc: Ovnimizer processes your data locally whenever technically possible. Files and text stay on your device — nothing is uploaded to a server.
home.featureInstantDesc: No sign-up, no waiting. Tools run the moment the page loads.
home.featurePrivateDesc: Everything runs in your browser. Your data never leaves your device.
home.featureOfflineDesc: Browser-only tools keep working without a connection.
home.faqQ1: Are my files and data uploaded anywhere?
home.faqA1: No. Browser-only tools process everything locally on your device. Nothing is sent to a server.
home.faqA2: Never. Every tool works instantly with no sign-up.
home.faqA3: Yes — Ovnimizer is a free, open-source project built for the developer community.
